nom: Cetaphil Daily Facial Cleanser Face Wash Fragrance Free for Sensitive Skin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin (including combination-oily) report the cleanser removes excess oil and helps prevent breakouts without being stripping.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: some say it cleans without tightness and even feels moisturizing, while others report it leaves their dry skin feeling tight or dried out.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as reliable across shifting oily/dry patches and report it helps with acne-prone combination skin without breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, eczema, contact dermatitis or psoriasis repeatedly report no irritation, redness or flare-ups and credit the fragrance-free formula.
segments.mature: No reviewers specifically describe mature skin.

concerns.aging: No reviewers report on visible aging effects such as fine lines or firmness.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it cleanses without leaving skin tight or dry and several describe it as hydrating or soothing, but a minority (2, 4, 7, 18, 19) report it leaves skin feeling dry or tight.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness or flare-up-prone skin (eczema, dermatitis, sensitive days) report calmer skin and fewer flare-ups, with one review noting improved redness reduction alongside some dryness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers concerned with barrier health say it cleanses without weakening the barrier and one contrasts it favorably with a salicylic-acid cleanser that had weakened her barrier.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with dryness reports the cleanser lightened spots on her face; this is an isolated mention rather than a common finding.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who are acne- or breakout-prone report fewer breakouts, clearer skin and less visible pores over time, with no reviewer describing new or worsened acne from use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report it controls excess oil and minimizes pore appearance without over-drying, though one combination-to-oily reviewer notes it doesn't fully remove makeup or sunscreen on its own.

aspects.libelle: Hard to dispense when bottle nearly empty

extraits.texte: I will never understand the hype around this product. I have combination skin that leans towards the dry side and this product is always recommended. Well I'm glad that it has no real scent, it does nothing for my skin. It often leads to dryness and I always feel like there's a film of product left on my skin which is an uncomfortable feeling. I do like to get sample boxes and it seems to be in every sample box I get. I know just give it to a friend who enjoys it because as far as facial cleansers go, I have found many that are quite more effective than this one. I also prefer a more luxurious feeling whether it be from a drugstore or a high-end brand. This does not feel luxurious nor does it provide what my skin needs.

I have super oily skin and this helps a lot. It doesn't leave any residue- just rinse well. It doesn't make my skin dry up or feel tight and that is just what i look for. It's great for my mums sensitive skin

I struggle with dryness and sensitivity, and this cleanser manages to clean without ever leaving my skin irritated, itchy, or tight. The formula feels light, rinses off easily, and keeps my face feeling clean. What I appreciate most is that it doesn't contain fragrances or unnecessary ingredients that usually trigger flare-ups. Instead, it feels soothing and safe for everyday use, which is huge when you deal with eczema. Over time, I've noticed fewer dry patches and an overall improvement in how my skin looks and feels. This one is definitely worth adding to your routine.

This gentle cleanser is great for my sensitive skin. I have contact dermatitis and eczema so many other cleansers have fragrances that irritate and dry my skin. Cetaphil was recommended by my dermatologist and I have been satisfied with the results.

I have struggled with combo, acne prone skin for a while now. My barrier has also been in need of some help and this wash has been keeping me on the right track. I relied on another cleanser containing Salysic Acid 2% morning and evening for 3 to 4 years now and while yes it helped my acne it also weakened my barrier and i did not properly use spf in the morning with it. Cetaphil is my new go to and i wish this was sponsored LOL

I saw a bunch of comments about the smell, and it's not amazing, but the product is fragrance free so what do you expect? It's not overpowering and it doesn't linger. But it definitely cleans well without irritating my eczema, something I didn't think was possible. I was using Philosophy Purity cleanser for a long long time, but it left me very dry. This is much better suited for sensitive skin. Definitely a lesson learned that sometimes the best product isn't the most expensive!

extraits.titre: If you have sensitive skin, this is the way to go
extraits.texte: The bottle is super huge. My face feels super clean after using without the sensation of dryness or tightness. I love it because it's super gentle with my skin condition, which is psoriasis and help me clear my skin.
